title: cert.rs: expired anchor short-circuits when second valid anchor exists
description: In validate_chain(), the trust-anchor loop calls check_validity(anchor, now)? inside the for loop. If two trust anchors share the same subject name (e.g., a CA that renewed its cert with the same DN) and the first match is expired, the ? propagates Err immediately without checking the second anchor. The second, valid anchor is never tried, causing a valid chain to be rejected. Trigger: trust_anchors contains [expired_root, valid_root] where both have subject == current.issuer.
